motions.label: Purposeful Motion
motions.purpose: add motion only when it clarifies state, continuity, feedback, or a spatial relationship
motions.fallback: preserve the complete final state and normal document flow with motion disabled
avoid: motion before the product relationship is known

motions.label: Micro Feedback
motions.purpose: make an input or state change legible
motions.fallback: retain visible state with no movement

motions.label: Panel Continuity
motions.purpose: show where a panel or detail view came from
motions.fallback: instant layout with focus moved correctly

motions.label: List Context Preservation
motions.purpose: preserve object identity while data changes
motions.fallback: stable ordering and selection without animation

motions.label: Route Object Continuity
motions.purpose: keep the selected object legible across list/detail transitions
motions.fallback: preserve object position and focus with a normal route change

motions.label: Scroll Narrative
motions.purpose: explain a sequence, comparison, or spatial relationship
motions.fallback: normal document flow with visible sections

motions.label: Media State
motions.purpose: communicate playing, buffering, recording, permission, or error state

motions.label: Model Inspection
motions.purpose: help the user inspect, configure, or understand a spatial object
motions.fallback: poster image plus ordinary controls and metadata
